visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro phase: A woman with black hair in a ponytail, wearing a red and white piped sports top and black leggings, poses in a modern gym setting. Behind her is a red brick wall and gym equipment like an elliptical machine. The lighting is bright and clear. (2) Muscle character intro: A man wearing a white tank top over a large, tan-colored muscle suit flexes his arms. He has messy black hair and stands in a different part of the gym with green turf and weight racks visible. (3) Segment 1: The woman holds a small glass bottle of Brand's Ginseng Drink near her face while winking at the camera. Then she stands before a mirror in the gym, holding her smartphone with a floral case to take a selfie. (4) Segment 2: The muscle suit character sits on a gym bench, lifting a single dumbbell. He makes dramatic, strained facial expressions with his mouth wide open. Heavy equipment and weight plates are visible in the background. (5) Segment 3: The muscle suit guy stands with his hands on his hips on a treadmill, looking sideways. The scene cuts to the woman running on a treadmill near a window showing a city view. He stares at her intently. (6) Segment 4: The woman is shown in a close-up, sucking on an orange-colored jelly stick from a Brand's packet. She looks directly into the camera with a playful expression. The background is slightly blurred gym space. (7) Segment 5: The woman performs shoulder stretches while talking to the coach, who is the muscle suit character wearing an orange baseball cap and a white polo shirt. They are standing near a power rack with weights. (8) Segment 6: The coach (in the orange cap) sits on the green turf, pulling a purple towel wrapped around the woman's leg to stretch her out. The woman's face shows mock exhaustion or pleasure from the stretch. (9) Segment 7: The muscle suit guy sits on a weight bench, leaning forward and staring intently at a smartphone held in his hand. He looks serious while ignoring the gym environment around him. (10) Segment 8: The woman pedals a stationary bike rapidly, looking extremely tired and sweaty. The coach stands behind her with his arms crossed, wearing the orange cap, urging her to continue. (11) Product showcase: Close-up shots of Brand's Premium Ginseng Jelly boxes and sticks on green turf. The woman and the muscle suit character are shown happily consuming the jelly and drink, flexing, and running with energy. (12) Outro: The muscle suit character walks away from the camera towards a gym exit. As he walks, it's revealed he has extremely skinny legs compared to his massive upper body. The woman stands nearby.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Intro section: High-tempo, upbeat electronic pop music starts immediately. A female voice speaks the title with a cheerful, energetic tone. The sound is clean and studio-produced with strong beat strength. (2) Transition segment: A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks the transition to the first character. The BGM continues with a steady 4/4 beat and bright synthesized melody. (3) Selfie segment: A playful 'ding' sound effect occurs. The female voice speaks casually with moderate pitch, followed by a simulated camera shutter sound. The BGM volume remains consistent. (4) Moaning segment: The male character emits loud, exaggerated grunts and groans with high vocal arousal and strain. These sounds are clearly designed for comedic effect, layered over the high-tempo BGM. (5) Treadmill segment: The BGM shifts slightly in texture. The female voice speaks internal thoughts in a whisper-like tone with low intensity. The sound of the treadmill's motor is faint. (6) Dialogue with coach: The music ducks slightly for conversation. A woman's voice is high-pitched and complaining, while a man's voice is calm. Clear articulation and casual daily tone are used. (7) Stretching segment: Exaggerated breathing sounds and soft moans from the woman are heard. The BGM tempo remains fast, maintaining a comedic atmosphere through electronic textures. (8) Bike segment: Rapid breathing and verbal complaints from the woman are paired with firm, encouraging commands from the coach. The vocal intensity is moderate to high. (9) Product Pitch: A professional male narrator takes over, speaking with a clear, enunciated broadcasting voice. The BGM swells with a more triumphant, energetic feel. (10) Conclusion: The BGM reaches a peak as the narrator lists product benefits. A final comedic silence occurs when the skinny legs are revealed at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Brand's Premium Ginseng Jelly and Ginseng Drink by using humor to depict common gym-goer archetypes. By showing characters experiencing fatigue or focusing on vanity, it positions the ginseng products as an essential energy-boosting solution for active individuals and office workers.
